definition: International trade in goods by partner country, formerly Direction of Trade Statistics (DOTS), with merchandise exports and imports disaggregated by trading partner
frequency_policy: download and profile each native frequency separately; never aggregate monthly or quarterly observations into annual values in this adapter
historical_scope: observed historical periods only; no projections; exact available period to be recorded after download
initial_bounded_extract: Prefer a reproducible official full-dataset download if accessible; otherwise use an explicitly bounded API extract with exact query and response hash. Do not silently sample.
raw_policy: immutable raw bytes, SHA-256, request URL, response headers, retrieval timestamp; raw excluded from Git
edge_scope: No edge until coverage profile confirms adequate annual historical panel and a separate within-trade edge contract is written
missing_data_policy: preserve missing and source status; no imputation, reconciliation, source averaging, normalization, or frequency conversion
entity_policy: preserve IMF country and counterpart identifiers as source-defined; map to CHAOS entities only through an explicit versioned mapping if required
promotion: no runtime or Composer promotion from acquisition; all new edges require null, chronological holdout, and supervisor admission
